Metadata.title: ARCHI-DESIGN Guinea · Architecture, design and creative trades
Metadata.description: Architects in Conakry: design, construction, building painting, calligraphy, screen printing and training. From design to the visual identity of your spaces.

WhatsApp.defaultMessage: Hello ARCHI-DESIGN, I am contacting you from your website.

Home.title: From design to the visual identity of your spaces
Home.intro: Architecture, construction, painting, calligraphy, screen printing and training: eight crafts in a single team, rooted in the materials and culture of Guinea.
Home.polesTitle: One contact for your whole project
Home.chainIntro: Each step builds on the previous one. Choose a step to see what we do and what you gain by linking it to the next.
Home.testimonialsTitle: They trusted us with their project
Home.ctaText: Describe it in a few lines: we reply within 2 working days, by phone or on WhatsApp.

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.text: Plans, permits, 3D model: we design buildings suited to the climate, naturally ventilated and shaded from the sun.
architecture.pack: Design + site supervision: one person in charge from the first sketch to handover.

interieur.name: Interior design
interieur.text: Layout, circulation, light and materials, planned from the drawings to avoid rework.
interieur.pack: Plans and interior drawn together: sockets, lighting and furniture placed before the concrete is poured.

peinture.name: Painting
peinture.text: Interior and exterior building paint, renders, finishes and decorative painting.
peinture.pack: Colours chosen with the architect, products supplied by our shop: one price, one guarantee.

signaletique.name: Signage
signaletique.text: Shop signs, plaques, indoor wayfinding: your building is easy to find and carries your identity.
signaletique.pack: Signage designed with the façade: fixings planned, consistent result.

decoration.name: Decoration
decoration.text: Murals, wall calligraphy, commissioned works: walls that tell a story.
decoration.pack: Calligraphers and painters work on walls already prepared by our teams.

mobilier.name: Furniture
mobilier.text: Custom furniture, designed for the space and built with local craftsmen.
mobilier.pack: Furniture sized on the real plans, delivered and installed by the same team.

communication.name: Visual communication
communication.text: Visual identity, printed media, banners and site hoardings.
communication.pack: Your identity carried from the shop sign to business cards, with one provider.

serigraphie.name: Screen printing
serigraphie.text: Textiles, promotional items, stamps and seals to equip your teams.
serigraphie.pack: Uniforms and items in the colours of the place, ready for the opening.
